title_zh: 设备与水岸维护公地资产全生命周期基线协议
purpose: Establish who owns, operates, maintains, pauses and retires each in-scope public/AI facility before adding automation or new procurement.
method_boundary: ISO 55001:2024 is a background reference for lifecycle, value, performance, risk and expenditure; this proposal does not claim certification or reproduce the standard.
evidence_entry_condition: E3 begins only after an authorised asset owner, verified in-scope asset universe, site access, waterfront/ecology/safety review and a signed Listening Receipt.
asset_register_fields: power, network, data and upstream/downstream dependencies
maintenance lead, cycle, spares and service window
fault, repeat-fault, incident and human-takeover history
noise, ecology, waterfront and accessibility constraints
cost status, warranty/contract, end-of-life and data-deletion route
baseline_method: Verify the real asset universe and owner from operator records; published media examples are not treated as an inventory.
Create a paper-first responsibility card and dependency map for each in-scope asset.
Classify criticality with the authorised owner and relevant safety/waterfront professionals.
Reconcile existing fault/work-order records and identify repeat faults without ranking individual workers.
Run announced human-takeover and offline-service drills for critical functions under an approved safety plan.
Test removal/retirement and data deletion for one reversible non-critical digital layer before expansion.
Only after the register is complete may an AI component suggest duplicate work orders or inspection priority; people verify and close records.

candidate_metrics.candidate_threshold: 100% for all in-scope critical assets before limited trial
set by verified criticality after baseline
set by verified criticality after baseline
must improve without transferring burden to frontline staff or users
100% for safety-critical functions before limited trial
100% of retired in-scope digital layers with verified physical/data closure

professional_gates: public asset management and authorised ownership review
park, water, flood and ecology review
procurement, warranty, maintenance and lifecycle-cost review
stop_conditions: unknown owner for a critical asset
no spare, maintainer or retirement route
uncertainty: The media-described devices have not been field-verified as assets; ownership, condition, faults, contracts, costs, ecological constraints and operators remain unknown.
